on the left: The bank is on the left, just past the traffic lights.
银行在左边，就在红绿灯的后面。
on the right: The post office is on the right, next to a small park.
邮局在右边，紧挨着一个小公园。
theatre (AmE theater): We went to the theatre last night to watch a wonderful play.
我们昨晚去剧院看了一场精彩的戏剧。
television (= TV): My father watches the news on television every evening.
我父亲每天晚上看电视上的新闻。
how many: How many students are there in your class this term?
这学期你们班有多少学生？
a lot of: She spends a lot of time practising the piano after school.
她放学后花很多时间练习钢琴。
lab (= laboratory): The students are doing a chemistry experiment in the lab.
学生们正在实验室里做化学实验。
have got: I have got two brothers and one little sister.
我有两个哥哥和一个小妹妹。
too much: Eating too much sugar is bad for your teeth.
吃太多糖对你的牙齿不好。
How about ⋯?: How about going swimming with us this afternoon?
今天下午和我们一起去游泳怎么样？
be good for: Fresh vegetables and fruit are good for your health.
新鲜的蔬菜和水果对你的健康有好处。
be bad for: Staying up late every night is bad for your eyes.
每天晚上熬夜对你的眼睛有害。
a bit: I'm a bit tired, so let's take a short rest here.
我有点累了，我们在这里稍微休息一下吧。
get fat: If you always sit and never exercise, you may get fat.
如果你总是坐着不运动，可能会发胖。
maths (AmE math): He is good at maths and often helps his classmates.
他擅长数学，经常帮助他的同学。
PE (= physical education): We play basketball on the playground during the PE lesson.
体育课上我们在操场上打篮球。
have breakfast: I usually have breakfast at seven and then go to school.
我通常七点吃早餐，然后去上学。
have lunch: Do you have lunch at school or at home?
你在学校吃午餐还是在家吃午餐？
have dinner: My family often have dinner together at half past six.
我们家人经常六点半一起吃晚餐。
go to sleep: After reading a few pages, he began to go to sleep.
读了几页书之后，他开始睡着了。
come from: My new friend comes from a small town near the mountains.
我的新朋友来自山附近的一个小镇。
look at: Look at the blackboard and listen to the teacher carefully.
看黑板，认真听老师讲课。
over there: The library is over there, behind the tall building.
图书馆在那边，在那栋高楼的后面。
kilo (= kilogram): She bought a kilo of apples and half a kilo of bananas.
她买了一公斤苹果和半公斤香蕉。
as well as: He speaks English as well as his elder sister does.
他英语说得和他姐姐一样好。
all over the world: People all over the world love watching football games.
全世界的人都喜欢看足球比赛。
be good at: My little brother is good at drawing animals.
many kinds of: There are many kinds of flowers in the school garden.
学校花园里有许多种花。
search for: I used the Internet to search for information about pandas.
我用互联网搜索关于熊猫的信息。
ha ha: Ha ha, that joke made everyone in the room laugh.
哈哈，那个笑话让房间里的每个人都笑了。
at weekends: At weekends, I often ride my bike in the countryside.
周末我经常在乡间骑自行车。
I'm afraid: I'm afraid I can't come to your party tomorrow evening.
恐怕明天晚上我不能来参加你的聚会。
can't = cannot: She can't play the violin, but she plays the piano well.
她不会拉小提琴，但她钢琴弹得很好。
take photos: Tourists like to take photos in front of the old tower.
游客们喜欢在那座古塔前拍照。
wait for: Please wait for me at the school gate after class.
下课后请在学校门口等我。
on sale: These winter coats are on sale at half price this week.
这些冬季外套本周半价出售。
go back: We had to go back home because I forgot my key.
我们不得不回家，因为我忘了带钥匙。
hot dog: The boy bought a hot dog and some juice for lunch.
那个男孩买了一个热狗和一些果汁当午餐。
get ready for: The students are busy getting ready for the final exams.
学生们正忙着为期末考试做准备。
at the moment: He is not at home at the moment; he is at work.
他现在不在家，他在上班。
